name: Slave Cherry
source:
"I exist to serve you!!"

Like Ignis, Cherry has been transformed into a submissive female slave by the hidden power of Arty Gear. She has been reborn as a bewitching female who seduces her master in a more lewd and unrestrained way than ever before.

Although she has been reborn, her naturally easy-going personality and strong curiosity have not changed... However, some parts of her have transformed into mischievous and innocent malice. In addition, by unleashing the sweetness of her kindness, she has released a part of her combat ability that she unconsciously suppressed before. Together with her innate overwhelming skill, she can now demonstrate attack power that is not inferior to Ignis. She has become especially skilled in high-lethality attack techniques.

[Translated from [url=https://i.imgur.com/9kcROeO.jpeg]official character description[/url]]

[spoiler]In the second part, Cherry's personality has been transformed to be more lewd and evil without anyone around her noticing, and she has begun various clandestine activities at the school for her master's sake, deploying various traps to increase the number of new female slaves for her master.[/spoiler]
